Now I will teach you Invisible. It is like wind, you feel it but not see. Like shadow when no sun, but still there. Like quiet when no sound, but not nothing. Like smell of beast before you see beast. Like cold of night when fire is gone. You know it is there even if eyes say no this is Invisible.

Discover now: clear water, silent step, big sky.
